headline: Presidential veto. VAT hike halted, budget to lose billions
summary: Poland's president vetoed a law raising VAT on certain drinks, which was expected to bring about 15.8 billion zloty to the budget from 2027 to 2036. He changed course on alcohol excise duty.
why: Budget revenue and tax policy determine how much Poland must borrow, which affects its bond market and fiscal outlook.
original_headline: Weto prezydenta. Podwyżka VAT zatrzymana, budżet straci miliardy
